selection_note: The owner approved the 14 CFR parts of the #641 candidate list on 2026-11-17. I selected them from publisher metadata only: the eCFR title list, the eCFR structure API and the Federal Register API. No Federal Register final rule of set 2, bench/caps, bench/dots or bench/patterns amends one of them. Selection never used a value or a model output.
label_method: Two blind label passes: pass a by Claude Code, pass b by Codex, each with the slots and the named sections only. A second blind check by the other harness on each absence. The owner decides each disagreement with bench/label/decide.py. passes.py seal writes labels.json before any benchmark model output on this set.
source_use: Each member is a US government work and is cited by its point-in-time eCFR versioner URL and SHA-256. The XML and the reader text stay in local work storage; sources.py downloads the same bytes again.

split_rule.seed_method: sha256 over the source_sha256 of the members in member order, one a line with LF
split_rule.rule: the 5 ids with the lowest sha256(seed LF id) in hex are calibration; the others are heldout

reader_text.code_digest_method: sha256 over sorted src/groundgate/read/*.py lines "name NUL sha256(file) LF"
reader_text.note: Text files stay in local work storage with the XML. Only their hashes are published.

section_text.description: The full text of the named section, without its heading and without the source note in brackets at its end.

definition.description: The definition of the named term in the named definitions section: the text after the term, to the end of its paragraph and of the paragraphs that continue it.

table_value.description: The number in the named cell of the named table, with the unit or the currency that the column header or the cell states. A cell with more than one number has no value.

table_rows.description: The body rows of the named table, one record for each row, with one member for each column header. An empty cell is null.

effective_date.description: The date from which the named section, or the rate or fee that it sets, applies, if the section text states one. A date of a source note in brackets is not an effective date.
